text:
Marta (PM): quick thread to lock down a pragmatic DP selection flow. want something we can run without overloading ops.
Julian (Eng): agree. infra can iterate faster with fewer high-touch partners.
Keisha (ProdOps): ops cap suggestion: 5 active DP slots, max 2 high-touch. keep 1 slot open for fast follow-ups.
Owen (Research): signal quality matters more than raw numbers. recorded sessions + repeat evals >> one-off surveys.
Pri (Design): coverage ask: aim for at least 3 distinct problem spaces each quarter (e.g., search, agent orchestration, embeddings-heavy).
Marta (PM): propose a simple scoring vector: engagement_prob (30%), strategic_value (25%), domain_alignment (20%), feedback_depth (15%), compliance_risk (10%).
Julian (Eng): compliance should be a router: "private-deploy" flag if needed, not an auto-exclude. also capture p95 latency target and session length in intake.
Owen (Research): tiny sheet friendly formula we can compute quickly:
```
score = 0.3*engage + 0.25*value + 0.2*domain + 0.15*depth + 0.1*(1 - risk)
```
Pri (Design): can we add a soft "infra-leverage" tag for partners that will exercise vector DBs, streaming, or tool-calls? use only for tie-breaks.
Keisha (ProdOps): operationally we'll require: weekly check-in, demo recording every 2 weeks, survey completion >=75%. I'll encode these as acceptance checks in intake.
Marta (PM): DP->beta promotion gates: >=75% participation, no unresolved infra blockers, and demonstrable improvement on a tracked metric (latency/cost/accuracy/engagement).
Julian (Eng): intake should capture avg prompt length, concurrency, calls/sec, expected traffic patterns, and whether they store PII.
Owen (Research): intake Qs to surface signal: "Eval cadence (weekly/biweekly)", "Do you record sessions? (yes/no)", "Primary success metric (latency/cost/accuracy/ux)". keep MC for scoring.
Pri (Design): timeline suggestion: shortlist in 10 days, outreach next week, onboard wave 1 in 4 weeks, run 5-week loop with a mid-review at week 2.
Keisha (ProdOps): dp-bot: please schedule nudges 48h before mid-review and final review.
dp-bot: reminder scheduled — will ping channel and assignees before checkpoints. :robot_face:
Marta (PM): actions: Keisha update intake + automations, Owen produce scoring sheet, Pri map coverage targets, Julian add infra fields. I'll draft a 1-pager playbook and post it.
Julian (Eng): ack, adding infra metadata fields now.
Owen (Research): will draft scoring template with examples.
Pri (Design): mapping verticals and small-team targets.
Keisha (ProdOps): updating intake form and will share link here when done.
Marta (PM): thanks — aiming for a recruiting shortlist by next Tue. :thumbsup:
